title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Task
description: A task is an atomic or composite activity that represents a unit of work, that could be stand alone or belonging to a process, manual or automated, performed by a person, system, or external entity. (TM Forum TMF701 Process Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component Task; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Task:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Task'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'Task' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Task:<tmfId>. unique identifier

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/description'. Indicated the description of the task: atomic or composite, stand alone or belonging to a process, manual or automated, and any relevant information.

taskCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/taskCharacteristic'. A list of characteristic(s) associated to this task

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/startDate'. Effective start date for this process

completionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/completionDate'. Effective completion date for this process

isMandatory.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/isMandatory'. Indicates whether the task must be completed before the process can continue, as defined by the process logic or engine.

taskRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/taskRelationship'. A list of tasks related to this task, relationships between tasks could be: triggers, isParallelWith, dependsOn, ...

relatedProcess.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/relatedProcess'. A relationship to an external process other than the process that contains this task, the relationship could be: triggers, isUpdatedBy, synchronizedWith, monitors, dependsOn, associatedTo, ...

parentProcess.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/parentProcess'. reference to a process object. In TMF this is a ProcessRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Process entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Process:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

taskSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/taskSpecification'. A reference to a TaskSpecification defined on design-time. In TMF this is a TaskSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced TaskSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:TaskSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/name'. The name of the task

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/channel'. The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

taskType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/taskType'. The type of the task, the BPMN standard distinguish different types of tasks like sendTask, receiveTask, userTask, manualTask, scriptTask, businessRuleTask.

priority.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/priority'. Indicates task urgency level for execution order and resource allocation; may be defined and interpreted by internal process logic or orchestration engines.

relatedEntity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/relatedEntity'. A list of related entity(ies) to this task, for example entity(ies) that have been created or updated by this task (a shoppingCart, a productOrder, an individual)

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/relatedParty'. A list of related party(ies) to this task

state.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Task/properties/state'. Possible values for the state of the Flow

BooleanArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

BooleanCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Boolean.

ChannelRef.description: The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

Characteristic.description: Describes a given characteristic of an object or entity through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

valueType.description: Data type of the value of the characteristic

CharacteristicRelationship.description: Another Characteristic that is related to the current Characteristic;

EntityRef.description: Entity reference schema to be use for all entityRef class.

id.description: The identifier of the referred entity.

href.description: The URI of the referred entity.

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

FloatCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Float.

FlowCharacteristic.description: Describes a given characteristic of a flow through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

modality.description: modality of use of this characteristic, it could be for example input, output, informational or contextual

isPopulated.description: a boolean to indicate if the characteristic is populated or not

IntegerArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

IntegerCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Integer.

NumberArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Number(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Number(s).

NumberCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Number.

ObjectArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Object(s).

ObjectCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Object.

PartyRoleRef.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

partyId.description: The identifier of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

partyName.description: The name of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

RelatedEntity.description: A reference to an entity, where the type of the entity is not known in advance.

RelatedPartyRefOrPartyRoleRef.description: RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

role.description: Role played by the related party or party role in the context of the specific entity it is linked to. Such as 'initiator', 'customer', 'salesAgent', 'user'

RelatedProcess.description: A reference to an external process which can be triggered, stopped or updated by the current task

StringArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of String(s).

StringCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a String.

relationshipType.description: The type of tasks relationship (requires, triggers, etc.)
